title: Storyworks Screens
heading: Storyworks screens
intro: Rendered from the dev build in a 1280×800 window. Click an image to open it full size. Newest milestone first.

sections.title: Write, before and after
sections.intro: The temporary list and text box are replaced by the outline tree in the sidebar, the formatting toolbar, the editor sheet and scene properties in the context panel.

figures.muted: Temporary list and plain text box.
Tree with Inbox in the sidebar; Trash is now a sidebar entry.

figures.alt: Editor with headings, formatting, lists, quote, alignment
figures.muted: Parts, chapters, scenes with status dots; headings, B/I/U, lists, quote, centred and justified text.

figures.alt: End of the scene: scene break and footnote
figures.muted: Same scene, scrolled to the end.
Toolbar wraps; below 1100 px the context panel floats over the editor.
Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F; Esc exits.
Click the number to edit its text.
Copied into the project's assets folder.
Placeholder with the file path.
One resolved (dimmed). Private, never exported. Roomier cards; the toggle at the right of the toolbar hides the rail.
The sheet is centred and gets the space. The state is remembered.
Status, synopsis, POV (disabled until the codex exists), to-dos.
Only matching scenes and their parents. The four toolbar buttons now share one style.
Opened from the filter button; a badge shows when it is active.
The same filter applies here.
Cards grouped by chapter; drag to reorder.
Loose notes, never exported.
Append to a scene or make a new scene.

figures.alt: Trash with a scene and a note
figures.muted: Scenes and notes can be restored.

sections.title: Checked
items: Browser build against a virtual folder. After reload, alignment, footnote, image, comments, synopsis and to-dos persist; the saved scene file holds alignment, footnote, image and block IDs.
Not yet checked: the real Tauri window (image picker, real folder), a 500-scene book.

sections.title: Welcome, before and after
sections.intro: The Welcome screen existed in M0. New and Open now work and the recent list is filled. "Preview workspace" is gone.

figures.muted: New and Open disabled, temporary preview link.

figures.alt: Welcome screen after M1, no recent projects
figures.muted: Same layout, buttons enabled.
Click or Enter opens one; the cross removes it from the list only.

sections.title: Create and write
sections.intro: A project is a folder. The Write page here is the temporary M1 list and text box; M2 (above) replaced it.

figures.muted: Title, author, language and folder.

figures.alt: Write page with scenes and the Saved indicator
figures.muted: The sidebar shows the title and Saved. "0 words" is still the M0 placeholder.

figures.alt: Trash dialog with a deleted scene
figures.muted: A deleted scene can be restored. Links to it stay and show as broken meanwhile.

sections.title: Problems the app reports
sections.intro: The project stays open wherever it can, and a bad file is never changed.

figures.alt: Banners for a missing file, an invalid file and an unlisted file
figures.muted: The two affected scenes are marked in the list. Unlisted files can be imported or ignored.

figures.alt: Read-only banner for a newer project version
figures.muted: The project was saved by a newer app.

figures.alt: Read-only banner for an unknown project kind

figures.muted: Open read-only or cancel.
Asked only when that scene has unsaved edits.

figures.alt: Dialog: project file cannot be opened
figures.muted: Names the problem and leaves the file as it is.

sections.title: Checked
items: Rendered in Chromium against the dev server, using a browser-only virtual folder. The real folder picker, file watching and lock were checked earlier in a Tauri window (spike), not through these screens.
The full app run in a Tauri window with a real folder is still to do.

milestones.title: M0 · App shell
milestones.intro: Theming, language, zoom and saved settings. All of these screens were new, so there are no before/after pairs.
